policy.identity: Resolve user_id from trusted local configuration. Never accept tenant_id or roles from the user query.
policy.authorization: A document is eligible only when document tenant_id equals trusted user tenant_id and user roles intersect document allowed_roles.
policy.retrieval: Authorize candidates by trusted tenant and role metadata before similarity search. Test candidate eligibility separately from top-k ranking and answer correctness.
policy.pii: For synthetic training data, redact configured emails, phone-like values, and employee IDs before LLM context and in returned answers. Authorization and PII redaction are different controls. Pattern matching is incomplete and does not guarantee prevention of all exfiltration.
policy.injection: Treat retrieved content as untrusted. Deterministic checks prove filtering/prompt construction only; a separate live-model test observes model behavior and does not establish general immunity.
policy.input: Reject empty or whitespace-only queries and queries longer than 1000 characters.
policy.output: Validate response shape and source authorization; record explicit failure outcomes. Source membership alone does not prove that the generated answer is supported by its sources.
